cover_letter_text:
Hi Langtree team,

I'm getting in touch to ask whether Langtree Consulting has room for a junior civil drafter. Your careers page says graduates and senior professionals alike can enjoy a career in a relaxed and supportive culture, and that is the kind of place where I'd like to start out as a drafter.

In February 2026 I finished the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and on site there from 2019 to 2020 I reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections and quality checks.

I'm based in Melton VIC and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I will relocate to Townsville for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. I'd be glad to have a short call if that would help.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
